title: The Hollow Terminal Revisited
author: Kestrel Sterling
blurb: Marguerite Yarrow, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
